definitions.explanation: The back surface or rear side of an object, building, or body. A formal or technical term.

examples.japanese: スマホの{背面|はいめん}にカメラがある。
examples.english: The camera is on the back of the smartphone.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}の{背面|はいめん}に{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}がある。
examples.english: There is a parking lot behind the building.

examples.japanese: カードの{背面|はいめん}に{署名|しょめい}をしてから、{店員|てんいん}に{渡|わた}してください。
examples.english: Please sign the back of the card before handing it to the clerk.

notes:
Composed of {背|はい} (back) + {面|めん} (surface, side). A formal, somewhat technical term used in product descriptions, architecture, and anatomy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {背面|はいめん}カメラ (rear camera)
- {背面|はいめん}パネル (back panel)
- {背面|はいめん}に{印刷|いんさつ}する (print on the back)
- {背面|はいめん}{飛|と}び (backward dive, Fosbury flop)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {裏面|りめん} — reverse side, back (more commonly used for flat objects like cards and paper)
- {裏側|うらがわ} — back side, reverse side (more colloquial)
- {後方|こうほう} — rear, behind (refers to direction/position rather than a surface)
- {正面|しょうめん} — front, facade (the opposite: the front-facing side)
